title: glance-marks.jsonl: one line per mark the Reviewer records (contract 1.12.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.12.0. Each line of glance-marks.jsonl, beside confidence.json in a harness release directory, is one of these, as one JSON object on one line. Appended by `harness glance mark`; never edited: a changed mind is a new line, and the latest line for a finding (kind and key) is its mark. Read by `harness glance status` and `harness scoreboard append`. Marks never change the Gate or an exit code. Derived from MarkRecord in src/glance/marks.ts. Not stable.

item.description: The item's rank when it was marked.

key.description: The finding's key: the mark applies to kind and key, so a re-score that reorders the glance keeps it on its finding.

by.description: Who looked: the Reviewer (SOP: authored no PR in the release).

becomes.description: verified: counts towards go; disputed: becomes a new claim or a hold; escalated: becomes a 5 Whys.

whyWanted.description: Escalated: the seam for C4 (harness why), which opens a 5 Whys on why the harness could not show it.
